text:
alex: Heads-up 1: working on a model card + catalog entry for Aurelia-13B. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4398

priya: nice. what are the open items you want eyes on?

alex: main things:
- confirm supported quant configs and mention experimental ones
- final sequence limit (we saw both 4096 and 8192 reported by infra runs)
- add explicit benchmark rig (instance, batch, seq) and raw CSV
- sync on SDK snippets: sync generation, streaming chat, and embeddings example

lucas: quant: stable on q4f16 and int8 for Aurelia on our kernels. int4 produces occasional decode errors on older cuBLAS; mark as "experimental" and link to infra ticket.

rebecca: for sequence limits, runtime currently enforces 4096 for hosted; Dedicated can do 8192 with specific host flags. Docs should show "hosted: 4096 (platform limit)" and "dedicated: up to 8192 with config" and point to the rollout issue.

alex: good, I'll split the limits table accordingly.

priya: SDK snippets: prefer short streaming example first then a one-shot generate example. Also add an embeddings snippet showing model alias for search.

alex: added snippets to the PR. streaming example:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.chat.stream(model="aurelia-13b") as stream:
    for part in stream:
        print(part.delta, end="")
```

lucas: Could we include a small migration note for teams coming from Orion/Zephyr? tokenizer and kv cache are the usual gotchas.

alex: added a migration callout: "If migrating from Orion, set tokenizer: aurelia-tokenizer-v1 and enable kv_cache to preserve generation quality." Example in YAML included.

infra-bot: @alex Please attach benchmark CSV to PR to ensure analytics can ingest. Required fields: instance_type, gpu_mem, batch, seq, tokens/s, wall_time.

alex: attached aurelia-13b-bench-2026-03-20.csv to the PR. All runs on ded-A100-80G, batch=4, seq=2048 unless stated.

rebecca: small wording nit: change "throughput" column header to "inference throughput (tokens/s)" and add a per-token cost estimate based on current pricing.

alex: done. added per-token cost row and included pricing note.

priya: also flag the tokenizer mismatch bug for older SDK clients and link runtime issue #812. Some customers will need to upgrade their client to avoid tokenization drift.

lucas: noted. I'll file a follow-up perf ticket to double-check int4 flakiness across the cluster.

docs-bot: PR #4398 opened and assigned to @priya and @lucas for review.

alex: pushed another commit addressing the header change, clarified the hosted/dedicated limits, and added the migration YAML snippet.

priya: reviewing now, will post line comments.

lucas: lgtm on quant section and migration text.

priya: left 2 minor copy edits. overall LGTM.

alex: thanks. planning to merge tomorrow if no further objections.

infra-bot: FYI automatic deployment of the model card will run after merge; expect cache TTL ~10m.

rebecca: :+1: publish date?

alex: scheduling for 2026-03-26. I'll ping ops if anything changes.

docs-bot: Status: changes requested (minor).

alex: addressed the minor edits, rebased, and force-pushed. Ready for final approval.

priya: approved and merging.

alex: merged and queued for publish. thanks all! :rocket:
